baseline.split: Original VCoR splits; exact/identical-dHash duplicates removed, no vehicle identity grouping available
baseline.method: Frozen general ImageNet MobileNetV3 features + original RGB/HSV statistics + independently trained MLP decision head
baseline.optimizer: AdamW lr=0.001 weight_decay=0.01; cosine decay over max100 epochs; early stop after15 unimproved epochs, minimum30
baseline.loss: Weighted cross entropy; inverse-sqrt class counts; label smoothing 0.03
baseline.timing_scope: seconds measures MLP training/validation, excluding data preparation and frozen feature extraction

cnn.selection: Mean of VCoR validation and 23 development reviews, validation >=88%; tests excluded

paint.selection: Mean VCoR validation and separate 23 Stanford development reviews; validation >=88%; no tests/city samples used

method: Own VCoR heads; validated full/body panel mixture retained from v1.3; calibrated uncertain-colour indication in v1.4.
optimizer: Используемые головы: CNN AdamW backbone0.00008/head0.001, MLP AdamW0.001. Смесь: сетка весов0.25 по development, без градиентного обучения.
loss: Weighted CE, smoothing0.03 в головах; смесь выбирается по development
timing_scope: Mixture evidence extraction/selection only; actual component histories/timings are in component_training
split: Original VCoR split; exact SHA256/identical dHash duplicates removed; vehicle IDs unavailable
selection: Coarse simplex weights in 0.25 steps over three own trained heads and full/lower-body views; maximize mean VCoR validation and 23 separate development accuracy, VCoR>=88%; city examples and both tests excluded

v14_calibration.selection: Full/body panel mixture, confidence power in 0/1/2/4; VCoR validation accuracy must not fall below v1.3. Maximize mean validation and declared 23-image development accuracy. No city photo or test used for selection.
